prompt: Review whether Valero has a material causal relationship to crude-product dislocation and refining margins through regional crack spreads, throughput reliability and cash conversion; accept or reject the edge.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: Regional product cracks transmit directly through Valero's realized refining margin, throughput and cash conversion, moderated by refinery reliability, turnaround and compliance costs, working capital, sustaining investment and cycle normalization.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject or invalidate if primary evidence does not show material crack-spread transmission to realized margins and per-share cash value, or if outages, sustaining costs, compliance burdens, working-capital reversal or capital allocation consistently offset the cycle exposure.
